_note: Every line in the game (M8; DESIGN.md 'Dialogue system'): family talk, radio calls, creatures and cutscene captions. Fields: id; speaker (config.story.speakers); channel 'radio' (a call while Tom's out), 'face' (said in the room; heard as a radio call when Tom's away) or 'caption'; text ({name} fills in from the caller); when { night: [min, max], phase: [...], all: [flags], none: [flags] }; priority (higher first); on (an event that plays it); next (the line that follows it); repeatable (never marked heard; dropped, not queued, if the radio's busy); kind (the radio's rate-limit kind); urgent (cuts the radio's queue, with the alarm pips); script (plays from its trigger only while that script is live: config.story.liveScripts); cue (where the line will be triggered, for the session that wires it); cued (M9.2: played only by the system named in its cue, never picked by talking to the family); draft (M9.2: written by the session for Aaron to edit). New lines are written with each encounter, with Aaron (Session 11).

lines.cue: Opening, Tom wakes (the cutscene opening.wake plays it)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Tom. Wake up. Something's happened at the facility. Every channel's static except the emergency band.

lines.cue: Opening, end (follows line 1)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: I need eyes on the woods. Get up the tower and tell me what you see.

lines.cue: Top of the tower (the cutscene day1.tower plays it)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Dad, there's a car down at the campground. Those campers checked in two days ago. They never checked out.

lines.cue: After line 3
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: Their fire's out. I saw the smoke over the trees last night, from my window. It's gone now.

lines.cue: Campsite sweep (sweep.campsite plays it)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Their car's still there, Dad. Check the tents. Maybe somebody made it.

lines.cue: Camcorder picked up (Campsite)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Play it, Tom. Whatever they saw, I need to know.

lines.cue: After the clip (Campsite)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: That wasn't an animal. I've heard things like that before, on the recordings. Please be careful.

lines.cue: Shotgun picked up, wave starts (Campsite)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Dad, behind you! In the trees!

lines.cue: Wave cleared (Campsite)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: They didn't stop when you hit them. They just kept coming until they couldn't.

lines.cue: After line 9
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: The dead aren't supposed to get up, Tom. Pull the battery from their car and come home. We need it to get the fence running again, to keep everyone safe.

lines.cue: Entering the compound after the campsite, no battery fitted yet (FirstDay)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: East fence is torn up. The ledger's on the desk in the comms room. Patch it with the scrap you found.

lines.cue: Fence repaired on Day 1, before the battery's in (FirstDay)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: That battery goes in the fence box by the gate. It'll put charge back in the wire.

lines.cue: Battery fitted; marker appears (talk to Junie on Day 1)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: Are they going to come here?

lines.cue: After line 13
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: They'll come. But the fence is live again, and we'll be ready for them.

lines.cue: Dusk 1 forecast
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: This is how we stay alive. Left side is what we've got: fence, doors, charge. Right side is what's coming. Keep the left side bigger.

lines.cue: Night 1, the first wave near the fence (FirstDay; Session 15b: {where} is the side it comes from, west up the campsite path)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Movement on the {where} fence. Only a few. The wire's holding.

lines.cue: Night 1, after Wyatt's shotgun line (FirstDay; Session 15b): the other way, and the rifle's beat (it can't be taken on Day 1)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Or get up the tower and take the rifle, Tom. You can pick them off from up there.

lines.cue: Night 1, after line 16 (FirstDay; Session 15b): one way to fight
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Meet them at the fence with the shotgun, Dad. Up close. The wire holds them still for you.

lines.cue: Night 1, the second wave rises (FirstDay; Session 15b)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: More of them, Dad. Coming at the {where} fence.

lines.cue: Night 1, the third wave rises (FirstDay; Session 15b)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Three more, from the {where}. That looks like the last of them.

lines.cue: Night 1, a few seconds before camera six (FirstDay; Session 15b): the warning
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Tom, one of the trail cams just tripped. It's live. Hold on, I'm putting it through.

lines.cue: Night 1, after camera six (FirstDay; Session 15b)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: That's the Pruitts' storm shelter, Dad. It's on your map now.

lines.cue: Night 1, after line 20; then the night fades to dawn (FirstDay; Session 15b)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Start at their gas station, Dad. There'll be supplies, and if Earl's phone or radio still works, we can reach someone outside.

lines.cue: Night 1, all nine down, before camera six (FirstDay; Session 15b)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: That's all of them. The fence held, Dad.

lines.cue: Trail-cam clip starts (clip.night1)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Tom, camera six. Look at this.

lines.cue: During the clip (clip.night1)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: She's burying something. The transmissions talked about marks like that, wherever the dead started rising.

lines.cue: Clip ends (clip.night1)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: The ground's still glowing where she was. Like it's warm.

lines.cue: After the clip and Wyatt's 'it's on your map' (FirstDay, after clip.night1; Session 15b: Ellen's now)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Earl built that shelter for his family. If they went out there tonight... Somebody needs to check on them at first light.

lines.cue: Dawn 1, sigil not dug up
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: We made it through. Whatever she buried can wait. Go to the gas station, Tom. See if the Pruitts are all right.

lines.cue: Dawn 1, sigil dug up
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: You got it. The night went quiet after you dug it up. That has to mean something.

lines.cue: Dawn 1, either way
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: She was singing. On the camera. Did you hear it?

lines.cue: Day 1: not up the tower a while after waking (FirstDay; draft, for Aaron)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: The tower's out by the east fence, Dad. The ladder's on the south side.

lines.cue: Day 1: a while after the tower, not at the campsite yet (FirstDay; draft)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: The campground's out the gate and down the west trail, Dad. It's on your map.

lines.cue: Day 1: home after the wave without the car's battery (FirstDay; draft)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Dad, the fence box is dead. Their car's still got a battery in it. Lift the bonnet.

lines.cue: Day 1: carrying a battery a while, not fitted (FirstDay; draft)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: The fence box is just inside the gate, Dad. East side, on the fence.

lines.cue: Day 1: the battery's in but the torn fence isn't patched (FirstDay; draft)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: The east fence is still down, Dad. The ledger's on the desk. They'll walk right in tonight.

lines.cue: Day 1: Tom tries the locked gate (or the torn fence) before the tower (FirstDay; Session 15b, Aaron)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Not yet, Tom. Get up the tower first. I need to know what's going on out there.

lines.cue: Day 1: the battery's fitted and Tom's outside (FirstDay; draft): brings him in to meet the family
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: Dad? Can you come inside for a minute?

lines.speaker: ellen

lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: Dad? Are you sure you're ready? Once that hut goes she's got nowhere left to run. You'll have to finish her.
